source: spl-token 8.0.0 (solana-program-library token program, crates.io spl-token-8.0.0, Apache-2.0): bench/real/o_spl_token
about: Open-source program, unmodified logic: the clean build is expected to have no finding; each variant removes exactly one validation and expects one of its rules at its instruction. Scored for rules only. Instructions by TokenInstruction tag. Common to all: token accounts, mints and multisigs are unpacked with their exact length and an is_initialized check; every instruction that changes an account writes its data, which the runtime only allows for accounts owned by the token program (check_account_owner covers the paths that write nothing: amount 0, self transfers, get_account_data_size); validate_owner = key == the stored authority and (the authority is a token multisig: m of its n signers signed, else it signed).

why.mint: Uninitialized (AlreadyInUse otherwise) and rent-exempt (Rent sysvar account, from_account_info checks its id). Permissionless by design: the authorities are parameters; mints are created and initialized in one transaction.

why.account: Uninitialized, rent-exempt; permissionless by design (the owner is an account key, no signature needed).
why.mint: Unpacked Mint (initialized) unless it is the native mint; token-program owned (check_account_owner).

why.multisig: Uninitialized, rent-exempt; 1 <= m <= n <= 11. Permissionless by design.

why.source / destination: Unpacked token accounts, not frozen, same mint, balance >= amount.
why.authority: The delegate (validate_owner against source.delegate, delegated_amount >= amount) or validate_owner against source.owner.

why.owner: validate_owner against source.owner or the delegate.

why.account_or_mint: Token account (by length): validate_owner against owner / close authority; mint: against the mint / freeze authority; a missing authority fails (FixedSupply / MintCannotFreeze).

why.source: Not frozen, not native, key relation mint == source.mint, balance >= amount.
why.authority: Delegate or owner through validate_owner (skipped only for the incinerator / system-owned case the program allows).

why.account: Zero balance unless native; destination != account.
why.authority: validate_owner against the close authority (or owner); lamports moved, data cleared.

why.account: Key relation mint == account.mint; not native; state changes.
Native token account owned by the token program (check_account_owner); only recomputes amount from lamports: permissionless by design.
as initialize_account2 (Rent from the sysvar cache).

why.multisig: as initialize_multisig (Rent from the sysvar cache).

why.mint: as initialize_mint (Rent from the sysvar cache).

why.account: Uninitialized token account: a no-op (logs); permissionless.

transfer_no_signer.removed: process_transfer, owner branch: validate_owner -> key equality only (no signature / multisig check); the delegate branch and the other instructions keep validate_owner
transfer_no_signer.impact: Anyone moves tokens out of any account by naming its owner, unsigned (transfer and transfer_checked share process_transfer): theft of every balance. The key equality with source.owner is the only remaining check.

verified.note: the processor handles most instructions inline in one function (fn_cf38), so the per-instruction bundle is not specific; the whole-program diff is the evidence: one call of validate_owner (the function returning MissingRequiredSignature) less, and one more sol_memcmp (the key-only comparison of the variant helper).

transfer_no_mint_check.impact: Tokens of a worthless mint the attacker controls are debited from its own account and credited to its account of a valuable mint (e.g. USDC): unlimited creation of any token without touching its supply. transfer_checked is affected too (its mint is only compared with the source's).
